title: The crown hanging in water
caption: In water the crown hangs in equilibrium: the tension 6.86 N plus the buoyant force 0.98 N balance the weight 7.84 N. The buoyant force is the weight of displaced water, so V = 0.98/(1000 × 9.8) = 1 × 10⁻⁴ m³ and ρ = 8000 kg m⁻³, far below gold's 19 300.
alt: Free-body diagram of the crown in water: weight 7.84 N down, tension 6.86 N up and buoyant force 0.98 N up, with zero net force.
description: Weight: 7.84 N down (the reading in air).
Tension (the scale reading in water): 6.86 N up.
Buoyant force: 7.84 − 6.86 = 0.98 N up; the two upward forces add to the weight, so the net force is zero.
Then V = F_B/(ρ_w g) = 1 × 10⁻⁴ m³, m = 0.8 kg, ρ = 8000 kg m⁻³.
